articles.article_text: Nvidia Corp. ranks as the fifth most valuable U.S. company by market capitalization after recently soaring into trillion-dollar territory, and the chip maker could have its sights set much higher. Shares of Nvidia NVDA have surged 194% so far this year, and they’re up 37% over the past month. With that backdrop, Evercore ISI analyst acknowledges the stock could face some “consolidation” in the near term, but he also sees massive opportunity in the future. articles.title: Nvidia board member sells $51 million in stock , joining a pair of other long - timers in unloading shares
articles.title_clean: Nvidia board member sells $51 million in stock , joining a pair of other long - timers in unloading shares
articles.article_title: Nvidia board member sells $51 million in stock, joining a pair of other long-timers in unloading shares - MarketWatch
articles.article_text: One more longstanding Nvidia Corp. board member has cashed out of some of his holdings in the wake of the stock’s stratospheric rally, though he remains a big stakeholder in the chip company. Mark Stevens, who’s been on Nvidia’s NVDA board since 2008 and served a prior stint as a director from 1993 to 2006, unloaded 118,602 shares of Nvidia across Friday’s and Tuesday’s trading sessions, according to a Wednesday filing. He sold at prices ranging from $429.90 to $434.20, meaning that he pocketed just over $51 million from the sales, which were done with shares that he held indirectly in a trust with his wife. Emily Bary is MarketWatch's assistant managing editor, tech. She is based in New York. Copyright © 2026 MarketWatch, Inc. All rights reserved.
